twoFactor.title: Two-step verification (2FA)
twoFactor.lead: When logging in you'll enter a code from an app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Aegis, Authy) besides your password. Required to save API keys.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the QR code in your authenticator app or enter the key by hand:
twoFactor.codesLead: Keep them somewhere safe. Each one works once when you can't use your phone. We won't show them again.

stepUp.lead: This change needs a code confirmation (valid for 5 minutes).

keys.title: AI API keys
keys.lead: Your own keys for generating questions. They're encrypted and never sent back to the browser, only the last 4 characters are shown.
keys.need2fa: To save a key, turn on two-step verification first.
keys.label: Name (optional)

models.title: Available models
models.lead: Models you can use to generate questions (stage 4).
models.none: No models available. Add an API key or start LM Studio.
